info.title: App Verify API
info.description: The Telesign App Verify API allows you to easily integrate frictionless phone number verification on iOS and Android using voice calls.

post.description:
Use this endpont to initiate verification of the specified phone number using the Telesign App Verify API.

To add this product to your account, [contact a Telesign expert](https://www.telesign.com/contact-sales?utm_campaign=contact%20sales%20form&utm_source=developer_portal&utm_medium=Referrer&utm_content=app_verify). This product is available for Full-service accounts only.

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) and [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only UTF-8 encoded unicode characters as inputs
* **Accepts:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Required headers:** `Content-Type - application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

phone_number.description: Your end user's phone number, including the country code.

carrier.description: The name of the company providing communication services for the device. This parameter takes the form of a string that can be up to 32 characters long.

connection_type.description: The type of connection the device uses, such as WiFi or cellular. This parameter is an integer up to 3 characters long.

device_icc.description: The international country code for the carrier for the device. This is an integer that is 3 characters long.

device_phone_number.description: The phone number associated with the device. This parameter is a string that can be up to 32 characters long.

is_roaming.description: Whether the device is considered to be roaming in the current network, for Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) purposes. It is an integer that is 1 character long.

is_voice_capable.description: Whether the device is capable of sending and receiving voice calls and messages. It is an integer that is 1 character long.

network_type.description: The type of network the device is in. It is an integer that is 3 characters long.

os_version.description: The version of the operating system the device uses.

platform_version.description: The version of Android the device uses.

verify_code.description: If you choose to specify a code (it should be five digits long), then you would add it to your initiate request as a string as shown in the example. You must have this feature enabled, speak with our Customer Support Team for assistance.

verification_timeout.description: The time in seconds that the handset is going to wait for the verification call to arrive, from the time it receives a successful initiate response. The call time is limited to 45 seconds.

post.description:

post.description:
If a Telesign App Verify API call is unsuccessful, the device will not receive the call. If there is a prefix sent by Telesign in the initiate request and it cannot be matched to the CLI of the verification call, you can use use this endpoint to report the issue to Telesign for troubleshooting.

To add this product to your account, [contact a Telesign expert](https://www.telesign.com/contact-sales?utm_campaign=contact%20sales%20form&utm_source=developer_portal&utm_medium=Referrer&utm_content=app_verify). This product is available for full-service accounts only.
